observations: Run 01M2SN3TE4FZ diagnosis was recoverable in three API calls (fabro_run_events search 'never_emitted'/'context_update_dropped' + prompt.completed details); seed descriptions built from the 200-char last_response preview misclassify prose+trailing-JSON responses as 'no JSON' — full prompt.completed payloads should be the basis for structured-output incident seeds.

Two nextest runs after an edit reused a stale test binary (identical failure, ~1.4s runtime, no 'Compiling' line) until `touch` forced a rebuild — silent staleness cost two wasted diagnostic rounds; a changed-source no-recompile run is a red flag.

Version-skew class: workflow assets (file-schema output_schema) can run on a deployed engine older than the engine fix they depend on; PR #235's re-enable of the planner file schema was correct at HEAD but re-exposed the blind-implementer failure on the older deployed engine until redeploy.
